actions.title: Harden chat cwd resolution for unbound sessions
actions.description:
## Context

Chat turns need a safe working directory when no repo is bound.

## Next steps

- Keep unbound sessions under WORKTREES_PATH/chat/{session_id}
- Reject `/` and TICKET-* paths
- Cover bound-repo and unbound cases in tests
